_meta.description: Exam-tier English word lists for the 'known-word' baseline of isHardWord(). Organized by level; see VIDEO-VOCABULARY-FLOW.md.
_meta.normalization: lowercased; only [a-z'] kept (matches frontend isHardWord replace(/[^a-z']/g,''))
_meta.notes: ielts extracted via regex from a prose-mixed source (fanhongtao/IELTS); 专四/专八 (tem4/tem8) not included — kajweb/dict ships them as zips on a CDN, needs unzip step. GRE words are advanced; exclude from isHardWord 'known' baseline if targeting general learners.
